chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) who said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, and Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, and Ibrahim ibn Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Abdullah ibn Hamad al-Ansari, from Sabah al-Mazni, from Al-Harith ibn Hasira, from Al-Asbagh ibn Nabata, from the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) who said: I heard him say:

Indeed, the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) taught me one thousand gates of the permissible and the forbidden, and what has been and what shall come all the way up until the Resurrection Day. Each of these gates opened one thousand gates, so that they turned into one million gates. Thus, I acquired the knowledge of deaths, calamities and the Divine Decrees.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet teach Imam Ali regarding the gates of halal and haram?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal* highlights the concept of *Ilm al-Ladunni* (divine inspired knowledge) granted to Imam Ali (AS), positioning him as the ultimate interpreter of the Quran and Sharia. The 'one thousand gates' metaphor signifies the depth of prophetic tradition, where each fundamental principle expands into a vast network of specific legal and metaphysical rulings, including the intricacies of destiny (*Mawt*) and divine trials (*Bala*). This underscores the Shia belief in the Imam's comprehensive authority to derive law and explain the unseen aspects of God's decree.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 28-12 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, and Ibrahim ibn Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Himad al-Ansari, on the authority of Sabah al-Mazny, on the authority of Al-Harith ibn Hasira, on the authority of Al-Asbag ibn al-Nobatat that he had heard the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali (MGB) say, “

God’s Prophet (MGB) taught me one-thousand gates to the forbidden and the legitimate, what has been and what shall come all the way up until the Resurrection Day. Each of these gates opened one-thousand gates, so that they turned into one million gates. Thus, I acquired the knowledge of deaths, calamities and the Divine Decrees.”
